purpose: Inventory public availability of the seven Table 1 baseline systems named in arXiv:2603.08127.
scope_note: This inventory does not count public project pages or runnable repositories as paper outputs. The Table 1 requirement remains the raw 30-query baseline outputs plus Gemini-3-flash judge records used by the paper.

baselines.name: Virtual Scientist

public_entrypoints.label: VirSci / Virtual Scientists repository
public_entrypoints.evidence: Public repository for VirSci, a multi-agent scientific collaboration platform for idea generation.

public_entrypoints.label: VirSci project website
public_entrypoints.evidence: Project website linked from the repository.

public_entrypoints.label: local runner probe
public_entrypoints.evidence: Probe found a runnable open-source platform, but not a drop-in runner for the 30 recovered EvoScientist Table 1 queries.

baselines.rerun_path: Possible replacement rerun candidate only after designing an adapter from the 30 recovered natural-language queries into VirSci's team-simulation setup. Requires AMiner-derived data, FAISS/Ollama setup, and patched local paths. No public EvoScientist Table 1 raw outputs were found.

baselines.name: AI-Researcher

public_entrypoints.label: HKUDS/AI-Researcher
public_entrypoints.evidence: Public repository for AI-Researcher, described as an autonomous scientific innovation system.

public_entrypoints.label: local runner probe
public_entrypoints.evidence: Probe found the public runner is benchmark-instance based and not a drop-in runner for the 30 recovered EvoScientist Table 1 queries.

public_entrypoints.label: Novix hosted production version
public_entrypoints.evidence: Linked from the AI-Researcher repository as a production-ready hosted version.

baselines.rerun_path: Possible replacement rerun candidate, but the public entrypoint is benchmark-instance based and not a drop-in runner for the 30 recovered EvoScientist Table 1 natural-language queries. Requires a pinned adapter or author-provided outputs.

baselines.name: InternAgent

public_entrypoints.label: InternScience/InternAgent
public_entrypoints.evidence: Public repository for InternAgent-1.5, described as a unified agentic framework for autonomous scientific discovery.

public_entrypoints.label: local runner probe
public_entrypoints.evidence: Probe found a one-shot QA CLI that can accept each recovered query and write an answer file, but this is replacement-only rather than paper-exact output.

baselines.rerun_path: Plausible replacement rerun candidate via `python launch.py --mode qa --question ... --output ...`, but the public repository does not provide the paper's raw InternAgent Table 1 outputs.

baselines.name: AI Scientist-v2

public_entrypoints.label: SakanaAI/AI-Scientist-v2
public_entrypoints.evidence: Public repository for The AI Scientist-v2.

public_entrypoints.label: local runner probe
public_entrypoints.evidence: Probe found an ideation CLI that can be adapted to the 30 recovered queries through per-query topic markdown files.

baselines.rerun_path: Plausible replacement rerun candidate via `ai_scientist/perform_ideation_temp_free.py` with one topic markdown file per recovered query, but the public repository does not provide the paper's raw AI Scientist-v2 Table 1 outputs.

baselines.name: Hypogenic

public_entrypoints.label: Hypogenic hosted platform
public_entrypoints.evidence: Public hosted science platform with Assistant, IdeaHub, and Arena.

public_entrypoints.label: Hypogenic Arena
public_entrypoints.evidence: Public weekly Agents4Science idea competition page.

public_entrypoints.label: local hosted-platform probe
public_entrypoints.evidence: Probe found hosted Assistant/Arena access and generated competition repositories, but no standalone batch runner or raw EvoScientist Table 1 outputs.

baselines.rerun_path: Potential hosted replacement rerun candidate through Hypogenic Assistant, but requires account/session access plus a pinned UI/browser capture protocol. Public generated competition repositories are related examples, not EvoScientist Table 1 raw outputs.

baselines.name: Novix

public_entrypoints.label: Novix hosted platform
public_entrypoints.evidence: Hosted production version linked from AI-Researcher public materials.

public_entrypoints.label: local hosted-product probe
public_entrypoints.evidence: Probe found a hosted UI with login/session/task endpoints and no independent public batch runner or raw EvoScientist Table 1 outputs.

baselines.rerun_path: Potential hosted replacement rerun candidate, but requires Novix account/session access plus a pinned browser or API-capture protocol. No independent open-source Novix runner, public batch API documentation, or public EvoScientist Table 1 30-query outputs were found.

baselines.name: K-Dense

public_entrypoints.label: K-Dense GitHub organization
public_entrypoints.evidence: Public organization with scientific-agent tools and K-Dense BYOK repositories.

public_entrypoints.label: K-Dense BYOK local app
public_entrypoints.evidence: Public local AI co-scientist app exposing an ADK chat endpoint that can be adapted for per-query replacement reruns.

public_entrypoints.label: K-Dense hosted platform
public_entrypoints.evidence: Hosted AI co-scientist platform with open-source scientific skills.

public_entrypoints.label: local runner probe
public_entrypoints.evidence: Probe found a BYOK local Web/API adapter path through ADK /run_sse, but no paper raw Table 1 outputs.

baselines.rerun_path: Plausible replacement rerun candidate through the K-Dense BYOK local app and its ADK /run_sse endpoint, but requires Python 3.13, OpenRouter/Gemini CLI setup, a pinned project/model protocol, and an output-capture adapter. No public EvoScientist Table 1 30-query outputs were found.

summary.next_reproduction_step: Choose whether to import author-provided baseline outputs, run open-source/hosted baseline candidates under a pinned replacement protocol, or explicitly report that exact Table 1 reproduction remains impossible from public artifacts alone.
